name: Overtime at Holiday's
storyline: A great opportunity arises for general cleaners Bill and Jules. Max Holiday's mansion needs cleaning, and they're just the people for the job! It's at the weekend, but the pay makes up for the trouble. However, when they find Max dead in his pool, everything changes. Suddenly, they find themselves trapped in an endless loop of overtime, forced to manage a dead body in a massive mansion. It's Weekend at Bernie's meets Groundhog Day, retro style!
summary: Overtime at Holiday's is a point-and-click adventure game. Cleaners Bill and Jules take a weekend job cleaning Max Holiday's mansion, but when they find Max dead in his pool they become trapped in an endless loop of overtime, forced to move his body around the mansion while avoiding security and the other guests. Players look at items, pick them up, use them and talk to characters to solve puzzles and find out how to escape the time loop.
